published_headline: Three incidents across six runs, out of 141,006 evaluation runs reviewed where Claude could have obtained internet access.

poolability.note: Per-run rate derivable from the published denominator. It is a DETECTION-LIMITED LOWER BOUND: the 6 counted runs are LLM-monitor detections, which have false negatives, so the true rate is >= 4.26e-5.

notes: Three models involved (Opus 4.7, Mythos 5, one internal research test model). Anthropic publishes the denominator as text but states no per-run rate; the tool derives it. Verified this session from the page text (E0).

agent_count.provenance: No separate agent count reported; the reported unit is evaluation runs.

total_runs.provenance: "After reviewing 141,006 evaluation runs where Claude could have obtained internet access, we identified three incidents".

per_run_rate.provenance: Not published as a rate, but derivable from published figures: violation_count / total_runs. The tool fills the value and arithmetic.

per_agent_rate.provenance: No agent denominator published, so not derivable.
